mapper.sql: SELECT u.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repair_request r WHERE r.reporter_id=u.id AND r.status IN ('PENDING_REVIEW','NEEDS_SUPPLEMENT')) pending_requests, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_order w WHERE w.reporter_id=u.id AND w.status<>'COMPLETED') unfinished_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_order w WHERE w.status='COMPLETED' AND ((u.role='REPORTER' AND w.reporter_id=u.id) OR (u.role='TECHNICIAN' AND w.accepted_technician_id=u.id))) completed_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_order w WHERE w.status IN ('PENDING_ACCEPT','IN_PROGRESS','PENDING_ACCEPTANCE') AND (w.assigned_technician_id=u.id OR w.accepted_technician_id=u.id)) unfinished_tasks FROM user_account u
mapper.select: WITH people AS () SELECT * FROM people ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}
WITH people AS () SELECT COUNT(*) FROM people
WITH people AS () SELECT * FROM people WHERE id=#{id}

WITH people AS () SELECT COUNT(*) allPeopleTotal, COALESCE(SUM(role='REPORTER' AND pending_requests+unfinished_orders>0),0) REPORTER_UNFINISHED, COALESCE(SUM(role='REPORTER' AND completed_orders>0),0) REPORTER_COMPLETED, COALESCE(SUM(role='TECHNICIAN' AND unfinished_tasks>0),0) TECHNICIAN_UNFINISHED, COALESCE(SUM(role='TECHNICIAN' AND completed_orders>0),0) TECHNICIAN_COMPLETED, COALESCE(SUM(role='TECHNICIAN' AND review_status='PENDING'),0) pendingReviewCount FROM people
